posts.title: Dramarama Spooky – The Exorcism of Amy: Stepping Into a Fever Dream Nightmare
posts.description: The Exorcism of Amy (1983) was broadcast by ITV as part of the Spooky strand of the Dramarama anthology drama series, which was a precursor to the main Dramarama series that was broadcast between 1983 and 1989.
